subject.title: fix(workboard): separate orchestration from hard dependencies

question: Should a pre-existing Workboard decomposition call that omits a mode change from hard dependency semantics to non-blocking orchestration semantics on upgrade?
rationale: This PR adds a public mode and changes the default behavior of omitted existing calls; code review cannot determine whether changing that established lifecycle contract is intended.

options.title: Preserve omitted calls as hard
options.body: Keep the existing implicit hard-dependency behavior and require an explicit orchestration mode for new non-blocking decompositions.

options.title: Approve the default change
options.body: Adopt orchestration as the default only with an explicit migration and upgrade contract for existing callers, documentation, and proof of the changed lifecycle behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve omitted calls as hard
recommendation.body: Keep the existing implicit hard-dependency behavior and require an explicit orchestration mode for new non-blocking decompositions.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Workboard lifecycle history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the dependency-ordering contract.
